name: independent-repair-field-type
purpose: Evidence repair: re-establishes a claim an earlier record recorded unreliably. Every step asserts and throws if its outcome is not observed.

steps.action: The field type is shown as text in Edit and a well-formed change is refused
steps.actual: In Edit the field type is not a control at all: there is no #field-type element (0 found), only the Type label followed by the static text "Single select" and the note "The field type is immutable after creation.", while Scope remains an editable control (1). The earlier record's "disabled=null" was that absence read as a form control, not a disabled select.
